scope: M73 original event timelines only; frames are conditional evidence, not portable deadlines.

repeat_counterexample.title: C2/C3 Friston death releases #13
repeat_counterexample.finding: The same Friston death and #13 release recurred; later Fang/Midnight damage did not re-establish blocking before leak.

c4_counterexample.title: #21 had output contact but no BLOCK
c4_counterexample.finding: Vanilla and Midnight damaged #21, but no BLOCK event existed; output alone did not stop it.

model_gap.plan_necessary_premise: The selected C5 plan required artillery attack occupancy to delay acquisition/contact enough to prevent a fourth lethal lower-civilian shell before source death.
model_gap.specific_enemy_behavior: enemy_1112_emppnt#0 DELAYED_LOCKED_AREA_ATTACK continued spawning locked area projectiles and did not impose a movement hold or acquisition delay.
model_gap.inexpressible_action: No supported plan action can request a movement hold, target lock, or conditional delay of artillery acquisition; current ordinary attacks select at ATTACK_STRIKE and no pre-swing lock is reliable.
model_gap.limitation: This proves only that the required occupancy/contact-delay premise was not expressed in the current model, not that some future legal structure cannot avoid the conflict.

unknown.claim: Whether the unexpressed artillery-occupancy behavior, if present, would have delayed acquisition long enough for the rest of the C5 timeline to close.
unknown.reason: The behavior is not executable in the current action space, so no full event test exists.

repair_requirements: State a concrete primary repair target for the selected structure, including the enemy, duty and window; do not write a generic survival/output goal.
Preserve or explicitly replace the verified early interception, roadblock-clearance and protected-target chain duties after any roster or position change.
For Friston pressure, require an actual live BLOCK chain through the release window or enough earlier kill pressure; range damage alone is not interception.
For #21/#22-style enemies, verify actual BLOCK plus sufficient kill or handoff; ordinary damage alone does not prevent a leak.
Recompute artillery acquisition, projectile locking, roadblocks #3/#4 and both protected-target routes under the new timeline; M73 frames are not reusable deadlines.
Track every skill-income, retreat refund, deployment slot, heal-target competitor and provider survival dependency; do not treat conditional DP as guaranteed.
Compare at least three substantive structures and make the selected plan executable without movement hold, reliable pre-swing target lock, enemy reset or unsupported artifact behavior.
